The three interlocking open curved lobes and central circular opening retain the selected biohazard outline. The source curved geometry is reconstructed with the physical stroke unchanged and fresh Index sampling, rather than shrinking strokes or dot diameters. No pathogen type, contamination level or handling instruction is implied. This keyed tactile recognition adaptation does not replace compliant safety signage.
